# A bill carrying GST, settled by the one gross expense split of an existing
# transaction.
#
# The bill is 100.00 net plus 13% GST, so it owes 113.00 and its posting
# separates the two: `DR Expenses:Supplies:USD 100 / DR Liabilities:Tax:GST
# USD 13 / CR A/P 113`. The transaction recorded the whole 113.00 as one
# expense, because at the time nothing said how much was tax.
#
# `txn_split_guid:` names that gross split. It moves to the payable at
# 113.00, which is what the bill owes, and the bill's own posting is what
# separates the tax.
#
# What this fixture produces: the payable settled, `Expenses:Supplies:USD` at
# 100.00, `Liabilities:Tax:GST USD` at 13.00 and the card at −113.00.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
taxtable "GST"
  entry:
    account: "Liabilities:Tax:GST USD"
    rate: 13.0%
    type: PERCENT

bill "BILL-GST-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-16
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-16
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: true
    tax_included: false
    tax_table: "GST"
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-16
    due: 2026-03-16
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-GST-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-16
    amount: 113
    account: "Liabilities:Credit Card USD"
    txn_guid: "99aabbccddeeff00112233445566778a"
    txn_split_guid: "aabbccddeeff00112233445566778a99"
